create_dino_self_supervised_model: create a DINO self-supervised Vision Transformer model for learning image representations without labels
build_net_wrapper_hidden_layer: build a NetWrapper to intercept hidden layer outputs from a ViT and pipe them into a projector network
build_mlp_projector_predictor: build an MLP projector/predictor network with L2 normalization for DINO student and teacher encoders
run_dino_loss_computation: run the DINO loss computation between teacher and student logits using center-aware softmax cross-entropy
update_ema_teacher_model: update the teacher encoder parameters using exponential moving average from the student encoder weights
